basic_info.description: Centrally located on Bernal's coveted West slope, with easy access to Cortland, Noe and the Mission, 229 Winfield Street offers value-conscious buyers a rare opportunity to reimagine a 1906 Edwardian from the studs out. Listed as a 4BD/1BA on the tax records, and showing as a 2BD/2.5BA with bonus rooms down, the home offers the rare opportunity to reconfigure and enhance a well-located Classic within the envelope of the existing structure. 229 Winfield greets visitors with a formal living room with views to Twin Peaks, a formal dining room, a family room or den nearby, a roomy eat-in kitchen and a laundry/mud room with a 1/2 BA, all on the main living level. Upstairs are two bedrooms, one with a private deck with peek-a-boo Downtown views, and a full BA. The home's ground floor, which features bonus rooms, a 2nd full BA, additional storage, and a one-car garage, provides the next owners with further possible home office, au-pair or expansion options (buyers to verify). Excellent central location, which Walkscore.com rates as a Walker's Paradise, is steps from Cortland, Mission & Noe shopping & dining, local parks, schools, & easy public transit and freeway commute access. Bring your tape measure and imagination and come see the opportunity on Winfield!
